title: Western Nepal faces 38°C heat as very heavy rain threatens hills - The Himalayan Times
description: Western Nepal faces 38°C heat as very heavy rain threatens hills  The Himalayan Times
publisher.title: The Himalayan Times
full_article:
Key Takeaways:

Dhangadhi/Nepalgunj forecast 36–38°C, Bhairahawa also up to 38°C

Very heavy rainfall likely in Karnali and Sudurpashchim hilly regions

Kathmandu cloudy with moderate rain, 28–30°C daytime

Pokhara 30–32°C with 60% chance of rain

Western Nepal is set for a sharp weather contrast on Friday, with Dhangadhi and Nepalgunj forecast to reach up to 38°C while parts of Karnali and Sudurpashchim face the possibility of very heavy rainfall.

Related Articles Nepal faces near 40°C heat as heavy rain forecast for several areas Monday weather: Heavy to very heavy rain possible in several provinces

The Meteorological Forecasting Division said generally cloudy conditions would prevail across the country, with moderate rain accompanied by thunder and lightning expected across large parts of the Himalayan, hilly and Terai regions.

Very heavy rainfall is likely at one or two places in the Himalayan and hilly regions of Karnali and Sudurpashchim provinces. Heavy rain is also possible in parts of Koshi, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini provinces.

Among the major cities, Dhangadhi and Nepalgunj are forecast to record maximum temperatures of 36–38°C, while Bhairahawa is also expected to reach 36–38°C. Janakpur could reach 35–37°C and Simara 35–37°C.

In Kathmandu, moderate rain with thunderstorms is forecast, with temperatures ranging from 28–30°C. Pokhara is expected to record 30–32°C with a 60% chance of rain.

The weather office said the monsoon is currently influencing the entire country. The monsoon low-pressure line is around its average position in the eastern parts and lies slightly north of its average position near Nepal in the western parts.

For tonight, moderate rain or snowfall with thunderstorms is possible in parts of the Himalayan and hilly regions, while heavy rainfall is likely at one or two places in the hilly regions of Bagmati, Gandaki, Karnali and Sudurpashchim.

Key temperatures: Dhangadhi/Nepalgunj 36–38°C; Bhairahawa 36–38°C; Kathmandu 28–30°C; Pokhara 30–32°C; Jomsom 23–25°C.

full_article:
In the heart of Nepal's Terai plains, presented around the world as a conservation success story, animal attacks have claimed hundreds of lives. In some areas, tigers kill up to three people a month.

Tensions are rising in these communities. Residents no longer just want coexistence; they seek protection. To better understand animal movements and prevent further tragedies, civil society groups are stepping in.

FRANCE 24's Fantine Dantzer and Tashi Bista report.

title: Nepali MMA prospects take centre stage across India ahead of Dhant’s Road to UFC bout - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepali MMA prospects take centre stage across India ahead of Dhant’s Road to UFC bout  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Nepali mixed martial arts is experiencing an unprecedented regional surge. While local combat sports fans eagerly await star fighter Rabindra Dhant’s high-stakes return at Road to UFC, three rising prospects are taking centre stage across India over the next fortnight, showcasing the expanding footprint of Nepali fighters in the regional combat scene.

The regional campaign kicks off in South India at Legacy Fighting Championship (LFC)-2, held at the Katedan Sports Complex in Hyderabad. Representing Nepal in high-stakes semi-pro bouts, Gokul Khadka and Asbeen Chhetri are scheduled to square off against Indian contenders Thushar and Adil Hussain, respectively.

The main action commences at 6pm Indian Time (6:15pm Nepali time) on Saturday.

Recognising the power of crowd energy on foreign turf, both Khadka and Chhetri have issued a passionate rallying call to the sizeable Nepali diaspora residing in and near Hyderabad, urging fans to turn out at the venue in full force and lend their support.

Khadka and Chhetri have travelled together for the same promotions in India before as well.

Khadka had defeated Roshan Jameeruddin by submission, and Chhetri knocked out Indresh Uniyal at Elite Contender Series-II in Kolkata in June. Khadka had also defeated Navneet Singh Brijwal at ECS-I in March as well.

A week following the Hyderabad card, the spotlight shifts thousands of kilometres northeast to Arunachal Pradesh for Aturto 4.2—Flyweight Grand Prix, hosted at the Artisan Cum Handicrafts Exhibition Centre in Chimpu, Itanagar.

Making his highly anticipated professional debut on the card is Rahul Hamal Thakuri, known inside the cage as “The Mechanic” and “The Bad Boy”.

Thakuri faces a trial by fire against India’s Darren Kharshandy. Holding a 1-2 professional record, Kharshandy brings valuable cage experience to the bout and will be looking to derail the Nepali debutant’s momentum.

“This is my first pro debut fight at Aturto,” Thakuri said in a video message on July 15 while signing the contract. “I am coming to fight. See you on August 22.”

These regional outings represent a vital bridge for Nepal’s blossoming combat sports ecosystem. The grit and experience gained by Khadka, Chhetri and Thakuri on the Indian circuit provide crucial momentum for the nation's fight community just as Dhant prepares for his historic bid on the international stage two weeks later.

नेपाली मिश्रित मार्शल आर्ट मे अभूतपूर्व क्षेत्रीय उछाल आबि रहल अछि । स्थानीय लड़ाकू खेल प्रेमी रोड टू यूएफसी म॑ स्टार फाइटर रविंद्र धांत केरऽ हाई-स्टेक वापसी के बेसब्री स॑ इंतजार करी रहलऽ छै, लेकिन अगला पखवाड़ा म॑ पूरा भारत म॑ तीन बढ़तऽ संभावना केंद्र मंच प॑ बैठी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ क्षेत्रीय लड़ाकू दृश्य म॑ नेपाली फाइटरऽ के विस्तारित पदचिह्न के प्रदर्शन करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

क्षेत्रीय अभियान दक्षिण भारत म॑ हैदराबाद केरऽ कटेडन स्पोर्ट्स कॉम्प्लेक्स म॑ आयोजित लेगेसी फाइटिंग चैंपियनशिप (एलएफसी)-२ स॑ शुरू होय रहलऽ छै । उच्च दांव वाला सेमी प्रो मुकाबला मे नेपाल के प्रतिनिधित्व करय वाला गोकुल खड्का आओर असबीन क्षेत्री के क्रमशः भारतीय दावेदार थुशर आओर आदिल हुसैन के खिलाफ मुकाबला करय के अछि.

मुख्य क्रिया शनिदिन भारतीय समय (नेपाली समय स साँझ ६:१५ बजे) सँ प्रारंभ होइत अछि ।

विदेशी मैदान पर भीड़ ऊर्जा केरऽ शक्ति क॑ पहचानी क॑ खड्का आरू क्षेत्री दोनों न॑ हैदराबाद आरू ओकरऽ नजदीक रह॑ वाला बड़ऽ नेपाली प्रवासी क॑ भावुक जुटान के आह्वान जारी करी क॑ प्रशंसकऽ स॑ आग्रह करलकै कि वू आयोजन स्थल प॑ पूरा ताकत स॑ आबी क॑ अपनऽ समर्थन दै ।

खडका आ क्षेत्री एहि सं पहिने सेहो भारत मे ओही प्रचार के लेल एक संग यात्रा केने छथिन्ह.

खड्का न॑ रोशन जमेरुद्दीन क॑ सबमिशन स॑ हरा देल॑ छेलै, आरू क्षेत्री न॑ जून म॑ कोलकाता म॑ एलिट कंटेंडर सीरीज-II म॑ इंद्रेश उनियाल क॑ हरा देलकै । खड्का मार्च म॑ भी ईसीएस-आई म॑ नवनीत सिंह बृजवाल क॑ भी हरा चुकलऽ छेलै ।

हैदराबाद कार्ड के एक सप्ताह बाद इटानगर के चिंपू स्थित कारीगर सह हस्तशिल्प प्रदर्शनी केंद्र में आयोजित अतुर्टो 4.2—फ्लाईवेट ग्रांड प्रिक्स के लेल हजारों किलोमीटर उत्तर-पूर्व में अरुणाचल प्रदेश में सुर्खी आबि गेल अछि.

कार्ड प॑ अपनऽ बहुप्रतीक्षित प्रोफेशनल डेब्यू करी रहलऽ छै राहुल हमल ठकुरी, जेकरा पिंजरा के भीतर “द मैकेनिक” आरू “द बैड बॉय” के नाम स॑ जानलऽ जाय छै ।

ठकुरी क॑ भारत केरऽ डैरेन खरशंडी के खिलाफ गोलीबारी के मुकदमा के सामना करना पड़॑ छै । १-२ के प्रोफेशनल रिकॉर्ड रखै वाला खरशंडी ई मुकाबला म॑ कीमती पिंजरा के अनुभव लानै छै आरू नेपाली नवोदित खिलाड़ी केरऽ गति क॑ पटरी स॑ उतारै के कोशिश करतै ।

ठकुरी न॑ १५ जुलाई क॑ अनुबंध प॑ हस्ताक्षर करतें हुअ॑ एगो वीडियो मैसेज म॑ कहलकै कि अतुर्टो म॑ हमरऽ ई पहलऽ प्रो डेब्यू मुकाबला छेकै । “हम लड़य आबि रहल छी, 22 अगस्त केँ भेंट होयत।”

ई क्षेत्रीय आउटिंग नेपाल केरऽ खिललऽ युद्ध खेल पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र लेली एगो महत्वपूर्ण सेतु के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छै । भारतीय सर्किट प॑ खडका, क्षेत्री आरू ठकुरी क॑ मिललऽ ग्रिट आरू अनुभव राष्ट्र केरऽ लड़ाकू समुदाय लेली महत्वपूर्ण गति प्रदान करै छै ठीक वैसने जइसे धनत दू सप्ताह बाद अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंच प॑ अपनऽ ऐतिहासिक बोली के तैयारी करै छै ।

Nepal says it cannot locate the original documents of the treaty establishing its boundary with India, complicating the border dispute between the neighbouring South Asian nations.

Foreign minister Shisir Khanal told the parliament that Nepal did not "have clear information on whether we possess the official treaty documents".

The Sugauli Treaty was signed in 1816 after the British East India Company defeated the Kingdom of Nepal in the Anglo-Nepalese War. The treaty significantly reduced Nepal's territory by compelling the Himalayan kingdom to give up swathes of land in the west and the east that would eventually become part of independent India.

"There are records showing that some documents related to certain treaties are kept at the National Archives. But we don't have clear information as to whether those are the actual official treaties," Mr Khanal said.

The search for the treaty papers began in 2016 after Nepal and India launched talks to review or replace the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship.

The Nepali side wanted to examine the original copy of the treaty, but could not locate it. So, the government gave the committee reviewing the treaty a second copy instead.

On 22 July, the National Assembly's Delegated Legislation and Governance Committee said it had searched archives, libraries, museums, and relevant government departments but couldn't find the original copy of either the Sugauli Treaty or the 1950 Treaty.

Nepal (Getty)

Relations between India and Nepal have grown tense lately as the new Balendra Shah government in Kathmandu has ramped up rhetoric against Delhi over the border dispute.

The long-running territorial dispute is centred on Kalapani, Limpiyadhura and Lipulekh areas in the far west of Nepal. Kathmandu says these are Nepali territories under the 1816 treaty, which sets the Kali river, also known as Mahakali, as the boundary.

The core disagreement is over where the river begins, with the rivals relying on different historical maps and interpretations.

Tensions flared after Delhi and Beijing agreed to reopen the disputed Lipulekh trade route to resume the traditional Kailash-Mansarovar pilgrimage.

Mr Shah fanned the flames by claiming that Nepal had encroached on Indian territory, a departure from the usual stance of accusing its bigger neighbour of occupying the Himalayan nation's land. "You will be surprised to know a fact that I have learned recently, only after becoming prime minister. Not only has India encroached Nepali territory, but Nepal has also encroached Indian territory in many places," the new leader said in his first formal address to the parliament.

full_article:
Kathmandu. A cultural property agreement between Nepal and America has come into effect.

With the implementation of this agreement, the US government's significant contribution is expected to prevent illegal theft, smuggling, and illicit transfer of Nepal's invaluable cultural and historical heritage.

The US has maintained import restrictions on archaeological and ethnographic materials from Nepal, implementing the cultural property agreement signed between Nepal and the US in Poush 2082. According to the US Embassy in Nepal, this restriction is believed to play an important role in controlling the illegal trafficking of ancient artifacts, idols, and cultural objects rightfully owned by Nepal.

With the new restrictions in place, archaeological items illegally taken from Nepal will be stopped at US customs and it will be easier to return them safely to Nepal. The embassy has stated that the US is fully committed to the security of Nepal's invaluable cultural heritage. The objective of this agreement is to enable Nepali citizens as well as American tourists visiting Nepal to experience and observe these cultural heritages in their original form within Nepal, the embassy stated.

At a time when the return of stolen ancient artifacts from Nepal from various countries has been increasing in recent years, this strict policy of the US is believed to have provided significant assistance in the campaign against cultural property smuggling. Such agreements break illicit trafficking networks, prevent American collectors and museums from unknowingly purchasing stolen items, and stop financial flows towards terrorists and transnational criminals.

It is said that this also ensures that American citizens can responsibly access and study global heritage and plays a role in strengthening relations between US embassies and partner countries. According to the US Embassy, with 30 such agreements completed and implemented worldwide, the US is understood to be leading in cultural heritage preservation.

काठमांडू। नेपाल आ अमेरिकाक बीच सांस्कृतिक सम्पत्ति समझौता लागू भेल अछि ।

ई समझौता केरऽ कार्यान्वयन स॑ अमेरिकी सरकार केरऽ महत्वपूर्ण योगदान स॑ नेपाल केरऽ अमूल्य सांस्कृतिक आरू ऐतिहासिक धरोहर केरऽ अवैध चोरी, तस्करी, आरू अवैध स्थानांतरण क॑ रोकै के उम्मीद छै ।

अमेरिका नेपाल सँ पुरातात्विक आ नृवंशविज्ञान सामग्री पर आयात प्रतिबंध कायम रखने अछि, पौश २०८२ मे नेपाल आ अमेरिका के बीच हस्ताक्षरित सांस्कृतिक संपत्ति समझौता के लागू केलक अछि ।नेपाल मे अमेरिकी दूतावास के अनुसार ई प्रतिबंध नेपाल के सही स्वामित्व वाला प्राचीन वस्तु, मूर्ति, आ सांस्कृतिक वस्तु के अवैध तस्करी पर नियंत्रण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाबैत मानल जाइत अछि ।

नव प्रतिबंध लागू भेला स नेपाल स अवैध तरीका स लेल गेल पुरातात्विक सामान कए अमेरिकी सीमा शुल्क मे रोकल जाएत आ ओकरा सुरक्षित रूप स नेपाल वापस करब आसान भ जाएत। दूतावास नेपाल के अमूल्य सांस्कृतिक धरोहर के सुरक्षा के लेल अमेरिका पूर्ण रूप स प्रतिबद्ध अछि से कहलक अछि । ई समझौता के उद्देश्य नेपाल के नागरिक के साथ-साथ नेपाल आबै वाला अमेरिकी पर्यटक सब के नेपाल के भीतर ई सांस्कृतिक धरोहर के मूल रूप में अनुभव आरू अवलोकन करै में सक्षम बनाबै के दूतावास के कहना छै ।

जे समय हाल के वर्षो में विभिन्न देश स नेपाल स चोरी के प्राचीन वस्तु के वापसी बढ़ि रहल अछि, ओहि समय में अमेरिका के ई सख्त नीति स सांस्कृतिक संपत्ति के तस्करी के खिलाफ अभियान में काफी सहायता भेटल मानल जाइत अछि। ऐन्हऽ समझौता स॑ अवैध तस्करी केरऽ नेटवर्क टूटी जाय छै, अमेरिकी संग्रहकर्ता आरू संग्रहालय क॑ अनजाने म॑ चोरी केरऽ सामान खरीदै स॑ रोकै छै, आरू आतंकवादी आरू ट्रांसनेशनल अपराधी के तरफ आर्थिक प्रवाह बंद होय जाय छै ।

कहलऽ जाय छै कि ई स॑ ई भी सुनिश्चित होय छै कि अमेरिकी नागरिक वैश्विक धरोहर क॑ जिम्मेदारी स॑ पहुँची सकै छै आरू ओकरऽ अध्ययन करी सक॑ आरू अमेरिकी दूतावास आरू भागीदार देशऽ के बीच संबंध क॑ मजबूत करै म॑ भूमिका निभाबै छै । अमेरिकी दूतावास के अनुसार, दुनिया भर मँ 30 ऐसनौ समझौता पूरा करी क लागू करलौ गेलौ छै, जेकरा सँ अमेरिका सांस्कृतिक धरोहर संरक्षण मँ अग्रणी समझलौ जाय रहलौ छै ।

publisher.title: The Hindu
full_article:
From the Nepal border to a bulk storage point in Wazirabad and then into the hands of local distributors, an international charas network had built a supply chain designed to keep the drugs moving while keeping those behind it out of sight.

Delhi Police’s South District police dismantled part of the network, arresting four Nepalese nationals and recovering 106.250 kg of high-quality charas estimated to be worth around ₹109 crore in an operation that stretched nearly 1.5 months.

Editorial | Caught in the middle: On India and curbing drug abuse

The operation began with a relatively small recovery of 8.598 kg at a residence in Kotla Mubarakpur on June 29 this year, leading to the arrest of Bharat Thapa, 32, Govind Budha, 32, and Jyoti Pun Magar, 50. Interrogation, technical surveillance, financial analysis and local intelligence eventually led the police to Roshni Magar, 32, who was operating a massive storage and distribution unit in Wazirabad.

A raid on the premises on August 12 led to the recovery of 97.652 kg of high-quality charas packed in 13 plastic bags. A mixing machine and packing material were also recovered.

A pictorial representation of how the international network operated. Photo Credit: Special Arrangement

Investigators revealed that the network sourced charas through suppliers in Nepal, including the Kakri area of Rukum, and moved it towards Delhi through the Sonauli border. The syndicate relied on road transportation to move the consignments to evade checks and reduce the chances of detection.

Who is Virender Singh Basoya? The mastermind of multi-crore drug syndicate extradited from UAE

Once the contraband reached Delhi, they were stored at various locations, packed into smaller packets based on the demand before being distributed further. Orders were coordinated through social media platforms including Telegram, with payments made both in cash and through digital banking channels. After transactions, the accused deleted digital communications to conceal their activities.

The drugs were then moved through local transport, including autorickshaws and bike taxis, to distributors and customers. Police said the network specifically targeted areas with a high concentration of younger people and demand centres such as Wazirabad and Majnu Ka Tila, with suspected supplies to distributors and customers linked to pubs, bars and hotels in the vicinity.

All you need to know about: drug addiction

According to DCP (South District) Anant Mittal, the syndicate has been in operation in Delhi for the past four to five years. Roshni had previously been part of the distribution network involving Thapa, Budha and Jyoti Pun Magar. After the three were arrested in June, she left India and returned to Nepal. Investigators said she recently came back to India believing that the situation had settled and resumed her operations.

The investigation has also opened up the Nepal end of the network. Binmaya, a Nepalese national, has emerged as an alleged key source who arranged transportation of charas from the Sonauli border towards Delhi. Another Nepalese national, Hari, has also emerged as an alleged supplier. Their exact roles, whereabouts and financial links are being established.

Police are now examining the financial trail to determine how money moved through the network and identify other people who may have financed, supplied, transported or distributed the drugs

दिल्ली पुलिस केरऽ दक्षिण जिला पुलिस न॑ नेटवर्क केरऽ कुछ हिस्सा क॑ तोड़ी क॑ चारो नेपाली नागरिक क॑ गिरफ्तार करी क॑ लगभग डेढ़ महीना तलक चलै वाला अभियान म॑ १०६.२५० किलो उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला चरा बरामद करी लेलकै जेकरऽ कीमत लगभग १०९ करोड़ रुपया के अनुमान छै ।

सम्पादकीय | बीच मे फंसल : भारत आ नशा पर लगाम लगेबा पर

एहि साल 29 जून कए कोटला मुबारकपुर क एकटा आवास पर 8.598 किलो वजन क अपेक्षाकृत कम बरामदगी स शुरू भेल एहि अभियान क शुरुआत 32 वर्षीय भारत थापा, 32 वर्षीय गोविंद बुढ़ा आ 50 वर्षीय ज्योति पुन मगर कए गिरफ्तार कैल गेल। 32, जे वजीराबाद मे एकटा पैघ भंडारण आ वितरण इकाई संचालित क रहल छलाह।

12 अगस्त कए परिसर मे छापामारी मे 13 प्लास्टिक क थैली मे पैक कैल गेल 97.652 किलो उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला चरा बरामद भेल। एकटा मिक्सिंग मशीन आ पैकिंग मटेरियल सेहो बरामद कायल गेल।

अंतर्राष्ट्रीय नेटवर्क कोना संचालित होइत छल तकर चित्रात्मक प्रतिनिधित्व । फोटो साभार : विशेष व्यवस्था

जांचकर्ता के पता चलल अछि जे नेटवर्क रुकुम के काकरी इलाका सहित नेपाल मे आपूर्तिकर्ता के माध्यम सं चरा के सोर्सिंग करैत सोनौली सीमा सं दिल्ली दिस ल गेल छल. सिंडिकेशन सड़क परिवहन पर निर्भर छल जे चेक स बचबा लेल आ पता लगेबाक संभावना कए कम करबा लेल खेप कए स्थानांतरित करि देल जाए।

वीरेन्द्र सिंह बसोया के छथि ? यूएई स प्रत्यर्पण बहु करोड़ ड्रग सिंडिकेशन क मास्टरमाइंड

एक बेर कांट्राबैंड दिल्ली पहुंचला पर विभिन्न स्थान पर संग्रहित क देल गेल, मांग क आधार पर छोट-छोट पैकेट मे पैक क आगू बांटल गेल। टेलीग्राम सहित सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म क माध्यम स ऑर्डर क समन्वय कैल गेल, जाहि मे भुगतान नकद आ डिजिटल बैंकिंग चैनल क माध्यम स दूनू कैल गेल। लेनदेन के बाद आरोपी अपन गतिविधि के नुकेबाक लेल डिजिटल संचार के डिलीट क देलक।

एकर बाद ऑटोरिक्शा आ बाइक टैक्सी सहित स्थानीय परिवहन क माध्यम स एहि दवाई कए वितरक आ ग्राहक तक पहुंचाउल गेल। पुलिस के कहनाय अछि जे ई नेटवर्क विशेष रूप सं ओहि इलाका के लक्षित केलक अछि जतय युवा लोक के बेसी एकाग्रता आ वजीराबाद आ मजनू का तिला सन डिमांड सेंटर छल, जाहि मे वितरक आ ग्राहक के संदिग्ध आपूर्ति आसपास के पब, बार आ होटल सं जुड़ल छल.

अहां के बस एतबे जानय के जरूरत अछि: नशा के लत

डीसीपी (दक्षिण जिला) अनंत मित्तल क अनुसार दिल्ली मे पिछला चारि स पांच साल स इ सिन्डिकेट संचालित अछि। रोशनी पहिने थापा, बुढ़ा आ ज्योति पुन मगर स जुड़ल वितरण नेटवर्क क हिस्सा रहल छलीह। जून मे तीनू गोटे के गिरफ्तार के बाद ओ भारत छोड़ि नेपाल वापस आबि गेलीह. जांचकर्ता के कहनाय छनि जे हाल मे ओ ई मानैत भारत वापस आबि गेल छलीह जे स्थिति ठीक भ गेल अछि आओर फेर सं हुनकर ऑपरेशन शुरू भ गेल अछि.

जांच सं नेटवर्क के नेपाल छोर सेहो खुलल अछि. सोनौली सीमा स दिल्ली दिस चरा क परिवहन क व्यवस्था करय वाला कथित प्रमुख स्रोत क रूप मे नेपाली नागरिक बिनमाया सामने आयल छथि। एकटा आओर नेपाली नागरिक हरि सेहो कथित आपूर्तिकर्ताक रूप मे उभरल अछि । हुनकऽ सटीक भूमिका, ठिकाना आरू आर्थिक संबंध स्थापित करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै ।

पुलिस आब वित्तीय निशान के जांच क रहल अछि जे नेटवर्क के माध्यम सं पैसा कोना चलैत छल आओर दोसर लोक के पहचान क रहल अछि जे ड्रग्स के वित्तपोषण, आपूर्ति, परिवहन या वितरण केने हेताह
